email.subject: Quick fix for Forge Pros Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked out the Forge Pros Fitness site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so anyone browsing on their phone has to copy and dial your number manually, and many just won't bother. Also, the footer still shows outdated info, which makes the site look unmaintained to new visitors deciding whether to trust you.

Both are quick fixes. I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes local business sites for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
